title: Learned preoperative record features improve retrospective orthopedic VTE classification
summary: Genetic-algorithm feature selection and a deep neural classifier distinguished recorded postoperative venous-thromboembolism events in a large orthopedic-procedure dataset. The final table reports better discrimination than using established risk factors alone. Patient overlap, procedure coding and model-selection uncertainty limit this retrospective result; no causal medication risk or improved prophylaxis outcome was demonstrated.
ai_technology: Genetic-algorithm feature selection with gradient boosting; fully connected deep neural network classification
organization: University of Wisconsin-Milwaukee; Oklahoma State University; Istinye University; University of Wisconsin-Whitewater

evidence.tested: The source derived 541,354 procedure records from 392,661 patients, using prior diagnosis/medication windows and coded VTE within thirty days. A 70:30 random procedure split evaluated a six-hidden-layer DNN. Final Table 6 reports AUC 0.901 after genetic feature selection versus 0.780 using established risk factors. The abstract instead cites 0.873, which main text assigns to a preliminary feature-selection stage.
evidence.unknown: Patients could contribute multiple procedures, and patient-level partition isolation was not established. Broad procedure-code ranges may include operations beyond hip/knee replacement. Genetic selection/tuning isolation from final evaluation remains unclear; excluding postoperative prophylaxis also limits preoperative applicability. The Table6/abstract difference is not silently resolved. Drug-feature importance is associational and does not establish medication harms or benefit from changing treatment.
evidence.ai_role: Learned feature selection and nonlinear classification linked preoperative record patterns to measured/coded postoperative outcomes, providing a specific retrospective clinical evaluation beyond a generic architecture benchmark. No discovered causal risk factor or clinical intervention effect is adopted.

source_review.scope: Read actual full primary PMC clinical cohort/procedure construction, endpoint/windows, holdout, genetic/GBT feature-selection and DNN Methods; directly read primary Tables4/6 and model Results. Abstract-versus-main AUC association and procedure/patient separation caveats checked. Individual records and detailed patient-level test isolation not reconstructed. Exact original article front DOI/title and fresh PubMed primary relationship metadata checked.
